summary:
A week where ALTR's billing operations visibly improved and everything that actually matters to this client got worse. The good news first, because it is real: Stephski gave Liza a heads-up the day before invoicing ('Hi love! Just letting you know your invoice will be sent tomorrow, so it would be great if you could initiate a OF withdrawl today so the funds hit your account in time!', 09-14), issued the Sep 1-14 invoice on schedule on 09-15, and acknowledged both incoming wires fast and unprompted - 2h37m on the 09-14 $1,500 ('received, still processing but I see it') and 23 minutes on the 09-16 $10,000 ('Its currently in processing on hold ill let you know when it clears'). For the first time in seven billing cycles Liza did not have to chase ALTR for a receipt once. Mica also delivered twice: reel inspo on 09-15, only 15 days after the last drop, and on 09-17 a genuinely proactive Instagram security advisory about mass logouts, backup codes and selfie verification - the first protective, non-billing, non-chasing communication anyone from ALTR has sent her in months, and aimed squarely at her stated #1 priority.

And then the rest. Vivek has now been silent for 18 days since taking plaintext passwords for @Lizakovaal, @lizkovalenkoo and @Lizaakovalenk0 on 08-31. There has still never been a single status line on any of the three accounts. Worse, we now have proof that nobody inside ALTR even knows their state: on 09-12 Michelle posted into the group chat 'hey babes this login below doesn’t work, can you check on password when you get a chance pls 💕' followed by '@Lizakovaal' and the password '[REDACTED-PASSWORD]' - copied verbatim out of Liza's 08-31 message. ALTR did not ask her to delete the credentials or rotate them; ALTR re-published one of them. Five days later Mica told her 'Please do not send your backup codes to anyone, including our team.' A new member was then added to that chat on 09-17 - the third membership change since the passwords were posted (ChatDeleteUser 09-03, ChatAddUser 09-10, ChatAddUser 09-17).

The client's own behaviour is the quietest alarm in the file. All nine of her messages this window sit in the Invoicing thread. She sent $1,500 unprompted on 09-14, wired $10,000 the day after the invoice on 09-16, volunteered both tracking numbers and the sender name without being asked, and said 'Yes we doing amazing job 😍😍🫶🏻🫶🏻'. She also left four separate ALTR questions completely unanswered: Michelle's 09-10 content chase (8 days), Michelle's 09-12 password question (6 days), Mica's 09-15 reel inspo (the sixth consecutive unanswered drop) and Mayson's 09-16 'do you have a facebook account available to use?' (2 days). She pays, she praises, and she has stopped engaging with anything that is not an invoice. Nobody has acknowledged the $5,000 under-credit she caught on 09-09 - 9 days and not one word about it. Derrek has been silent 45 days. And Stephski changed the ALTR bank account details for a SIXTH time inside the 09-15 invoice ('Please note a slight name change to the account, but the same account and wire info'), 76 days after 'last change I promise!'; the $10,000 wire that followed is sitting 'in processing on hold' at window close.

health.rationale: Down 3 from 58. Billing operations improved measurably and that is banked into the score: invoice issued on schedule with a day's advance notice, both wires acknowledged unprompted within hours, and zero payment chases from the client for the first time in seven cycles. Mica delivered two real proactive touches (reel inspo 09-15, IG security advisory 09-17). Those gains are outweighed by a new, self-inflicted failure and by continued decay on the two items that will actually end this relationship. NEW THIS WINDOW: ALTR itself re-published one of Liza's plaintext Instagram passwords into the group chat (Michelle, 09-12) - 12 days after she posted the credentials at Vivek's request, with nobody having asked her to delete or rotate them, and a further member added to that room on 09-17. That is a liability ALTR created, not inherited. UNMOVED: Vivek at 18 days of total silence on three deleted accounts he took credentials for, with no status ever issued; Michelle's message proves ALTR's own staff do not know those accounts are gone. Derrek at 45 days silent, Phone Farm 48 days old and 40 days past the window he named, and the $5,000 under-credit he has never acknowledged now 9 days old. Stephski's sixth banking change since 2025-09-27 landed inside the invoice, and the $10k wire behind it is on hold. The Sep 1-14 credit was again stated with NO NUMBER ('I've deducted the overpayment from last period + the 1500 you sent earlier') - the exact defect that produced a $5,000 error last cycle, except this time she did not audit it, so if it is wrong nobody will find out. Held up by flawless client conduct, fast payment, warm tone and Stephski's much-improved responsiveness. Held down by the fact that every one of the nine messages Liza sent was about money, and four separate ALTR questions to her went unanswered.
